basic_profile.bio: I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast and recent convert to the world of Electric Unicycles. Based in a bustling metropolis, I love exploring urban landscapes and occasionally venturing into nearby forests for some off-road thrills. When I'm not riding, I work as a junior software developer for a startup. I'm single and usually spend my evenings online, learning new skills or engaging in my hobbies. I dislike being stagnant and am always on the lookout for new adventures. My typical online hours are between 6 PM and 11 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in computer science and a passion for technology. I started exploring Electric Unicycles about six months ago, primarily through YouTube videos and online forums. My knowledge is growing, but I still consider myself a novice.
